evals.prompt: Create an SVG diagram for the siloed-qa-team anti-pattern page. evals.prompt: The testing-only-at-the-end anti-pattern page describes how testing as a sequential phase after development creates a lag. Create an SVG diagram that shows the timeline of a sprint: on top, the anti-pattern where dev occupies the first 8 days, then QA occupies the last 4 days (testing only at the end); on the bottom, the better approach where testing happens throughout all 12 days alongside development. The diagram should make the time-overlap difference visually obvious.
evals.expected_output: An SVG file saved to static/images/anti-patterns/testing-only-at-the-end.svg showing a timeline comparison. The anti-pattern row shows sequential dev then QA blocks. The improved row shows overlapping dev and test activities across the full timeline. Site color palette used, text fits inside shapes, legend included, figure shortcode provided.
